title: Business Central Trivia Recap: October 26–30, 2026
summary: This post recaps a week of Business Central Trivia with results from 250 questions across multiple categories. It shows that overall accuracy was 47%, with fixed assets and bank & cash management being the hardest topics and projects, warehouse management, and sales management being the easiest.
key_points: 47% overall accuracy rate, the lowest so far across all trivia weeks
Participants averaged about 124 answers each with two completing all 250 questions
Fixed assets and bank & cash management were the hardest categories at 29% and 33% accuracy
Projects & jobs, warehouse management, and sales management were easiest at 66-70% accuracy
BC Today & Trivia category dropped significantly from 81% to 32% accuracy week-over-week

quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the scope and scale of the weekly trivia event

quotes.text: 47% of the answers were correct, down from 63% last week. This is the lowest result so far.
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows a significant drop in performance metrics and indicates increased difficulty

quotes.text: Fixed Assets was in the bottom three again.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights that certain Business Central topics consistently challenge the community
